approval_delegation.scope: Every step already written into this track's plan, including third-party development tooling installs and per-task commits, may proceed without asking again.
approval_delegation.limits: Anything not in the plan still requires the operator's approval before it is done. Closure itself is not delegated: the closing condition is demonstrated and presented before the track is called complete.

gates.premise_review_note: Flowchart drawn and three gaps reported before initialization: coverage measurement had no tool, continuous integration had no remote, and the Aseprite binary path was machine-specific. All three were resolved by operator decision.
